run_webrtc_server: run a WebRTC server that exposes an ActionRegistry with a given host name and API key
serve_action_registry: serve an ActionRegistry over WebRTC with TURN server configuration and signalling headers
create_host_and_token: create a new host and timed token via the API when no active token exists
validate_api_key: validate an API key against the auth endpoint and retrieve the associated owner username
dynamically_import_registry: dynamically import an ActionRegistry from a module path or file path using importlib
